fingerprint_method: SHA256 over the fourteen ordered report row arrays, each in output_columns order, encoded as UTF-8 compact JSON with ensure_ascii=True, comma/colon separators and one LF after every row. displayed_aggregate_controls.interpretation: All 3796 UP/DOWN target transitions have a same-week/department unchanged reference in this report. FOODS_1 has negative weighted gaps for both directions despite positive gaps in 8 of 10 UP weeks and 9 of 10 DOWN weeks: weekly sign counts do not account for magnitudes and target-transition weights. This is a descriptive comparison, not a causal effect.
